svg.text: WHITE -> CH1 / PC0 RED -> CH3 / PC2 All GND labels join; all 3V3 labels join.
High-resistance divider -> clamps -> unity-gain buffer -> ADC
High-resistance divider -> clamps -> unity-gain buffer -> ADC
Do not power the chip from intercom RED.
C1 closest to chip. C2 stripe / negative lead goes to GND.
CHIP TOP VIEW — pin-1 dot upper left
Adapter underside is mirrored. Check pad numbering.
INSTALLATION: remove original 47 kΩ / 10 kΩ divider pairs on PC0 and PC2; leave PC1 unchanged.
BLACK -> common GND. YELLOW unused. Inputs 0–15 V only. Power off before soldering or rewiring.
Test off-intercom first: 3.3 V input -> 0.579 V output; 13.6 V input -> 2.386 V output. Nominal scale ×5.7.
Bench prototype: not isolated or surge-qualified. Keep buffer powered while intercom inputs are attached.
